summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the accuracy of dwell time calculations. It was noted that current logic might incorrectly use a single network's screen data for session duration while using cluster-wide data for the session number.

To fix this, it was suggested that developers review master templates to ensure proper handling of multiple networks within a single view. If not addressed, the calculation will be flawed.
decisions: The technical issue regarding dwell time and session duration/number discrepancies needs fixing.
action_items: Review master templates to clean up network handling for accurate dwell time calculations.
